_readme: Tree dictionary for /stemkit grow (no argument: the list), grow <name> [pos] and grow all. Edit freely, then /reload (or rebuild the jar to change the built-in default).
name : code name used in the commands (lowercase, letters/digits/_). Cannot be only digits, and cannot be all, warped or crimson, which grow uses itself.
variant : crimson | warped | unknown (unknown = cannot be grown by name) | sibling (planted only: the s0 grown as warped AND crimson side by side, warped left)
description, expectedShroomlights, expectedWart : shown in lists; grow compares its counts with the expected ones (expected* optional; the counts were computed with the repo's reference code)

highlight : optional short text shown next to the name in the /stemkit grow list (what makes this tree interesting, e.g. "58 shroomlights", "stem 26, 15-block hat"). Shown in shroomlight orange if it mentions shroomlights. Leave it out to show nothing.
NATURAL (vanilla natural feature, planted=false, thick stems possible). The RNG state is given in ONE of these ways:

derived : worldSeed, x, y, z + featureIndex, step, callsBefore. The state chunk decoration gives place(): setDecorationSeed -> setFeatureSeed(featureIndex, step) -> callsBefore draws (warped_fungi = index 3, step 9). A tree that exists in a real world.
recorded : atPlaceLo, atPlaceHi = the Xoroshiro state at place(). With derived fields too, the mod checks its derivation against it.

model : featureSeed + skip. State = new XoroshiroRandomSource(featureSeed) (seed upgraded to 128 bit) then skip raw nextLong steps. Our natural search's definition; the tree is not located in any real world.
PLANTED (vanilla bone meal, never thick): s0 = the 48-bit state of the level random just before the bone meal is used (same as /stemkit grow <variant> <s0>).
